config.observations_mission: Maintain a readable list of currently supported personal and project information. Each observation should state one subject and one facet clearly, preserving attribution, uncertainty and scope. Include each independently useful fact from the evidence, including relationships, preferences, possessions and explicit plans. Use the latest applicable assertion date, not ingestion order. For a correction, state only the corrected information; do not narrate earlier erroneous or superseded values or invent a real-world change. Keep genuinely historical events and future plans explicitly dated as history or plans, not present state. Preserve unaffected facts when another property changes. Do not infer ownership from questions. Do not combine unrelated facets into a profile paragraph.
config.retain_mission: Remember useful user-stated personal facts, preferences, constraints, plans and project decisions. Extract only the claims actually changed by that explicit edit. Preserve all subject/project distinctions. Ordinary user messages remain ordinary evidence. A correction or source edit is an explicit assertion at its event time; reprocessing does not make it newer.
